stage.deltaTitle: Modelled land-cover thermal contrast: this ward's mean surface temperature minus a fully-vegetated reference cell under identical forcing. NOT a measured urban heat island — published Kolkata surface UHI is 0.85–1.5 °C from 1 km satellite data, a different quantity.
stage.tintTitle: Building colour: continuous ramp, or snapped to the 5 legend classes

Canopy over the roof: usable or not.

noDataPaneNotes: There is nothing to intervene in here. The toolbox plants canopy, raises albedo and greens facades over a MEASURED surface, and {scope.area.name} ships none — so a slider would move a number that stands for nothing.
It comes back with the artefacts, unchanged: the model is not per-city, only the observations are.
stage.scenariosNote: Not built yet. The toolbox under Map runs one scenario at a time and keeps none of them: there is nowhere to save an intervention set, name it, or put two of them side by side.
notYetParts: This area is registered in the twin and has a permanent address, but no measured heat artefacts ship for it yet — no footprints, no surface temperature, no canopy. Nothing here would be a reading, so nothing is drawn. The instrument runs where the observations do.
